items.title_en: Louis Vuitton’s Autorickshaw Handbag Sparks Internet Frenzy, Users Ask: 'Pricing By The Meter?'
items.title_zh: 路易威登 Autorickshaw 手提包引发网络热潮，用户提问：“按米定价？”
items.summary_en: Helmed by Pharrell Williams, what really grabbed attention was the quirky autorickshaw handbag design, a playful blend of India’s bustling street life and Louis Vuitton’s style
items.summary_zh: 由 Pharrell Williams 掌舵，真正吸引眼球的是奇特的机动三轮车手袋设计，有趣地融合了印度繁华的街头生活和路易威登的风格
